summary: The candidate is correct and complete. The affine-circuit second-moment argument makes every forbidden genericity condition a proper hyperplane; complementary slackness and circuit genericity give an affinely independent boundary and uniqueness; the quadratic barycenter identity yields strict interiority and b_m = a_m < M; and the accepted fiber-depth and product-simplex results give (16), hence the constants in (17) and (18), including the q = 0 and empty-boundary cases.
